briefdescription.para: Lower barriers out of existence (if the associated GCStrategy hasn't already done so...), and insert initializing stores to roots as a defensive measure.

detaileddescription.para: Given we're going to report all roots live at all safepoints, we need to be able to ensure each root has been initialized by the point the first safepoint is reached. This really should have been done by the frontend, but the old API made this non-obvious, so we do a potentially redundant store just in case.

briefdescription.para: CouldBecomeSafePoint - Predicate to conservatively determine whether the instruction could introduce a safe point.
